block.comment:
Group unnotified campaign issues by Luma event (3h+)
Returns one row per Luma slug with affected guests, issue reasons, and queue IDs for the grouped Slack alert.
block.description: Select rows using custom SQL in PostgreSQL

extended_input_schema.hint: First provide the full name assigned to your bind variable in the WHERE condition. e.g. id Second, provide the actual parameter value. Parameter values can be static or datapills. Select the closest corresponding data type that your database is expecting for the bind variable
extended_input_schema.label: Parameters
extended_input_schema.name: parameters

input.sql:
WITH grouped AS (
    SELECT
        luma_url_slug,
        count(*) AS guest_count,
        string_agg('• ' || email, E'\n' ORDER BY id) AS guests,
        string_agg(
            DISTINCT coalesce(message, 'Campaign not found'),
            E'\n' ORDER BY coalesce(message, 'Campaign not found')
        ) AS reasons,
        string_agg(id::text, ',' ORDER BY id) AS queue_ids_csv
    FROM marketing.luma_sf_campaign_queue
    WHERE queue_status = 'Campaign not found'
      AND NOT not_found_notified
      AND created_at <= now() - interval '3 hours'
    GROUP BY luma_url_slug
)
SELECT grouped.*,
       string_agg(queue_ids_csv, ',') OVER () AS all_queue_ids_csv
FROM grouped
ORDER BY luma_url_slug
